shortDescription: Module for setup of NsxtSegmentRuntime Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: Nsxt segment belongs to cloud. It is a reference to an object of type cloud. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: dhcp6_ranges
options.description: V6 dhcp ranges configured in nsxt. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dhcp_enabled
options.description: Ip address management scheme for this segment associated network. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: dhcp_ranges
options.description: Dhcp ranges configured in nsxt. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Segment object name. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: nw_name
options.description: Network name. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: nw_ref
options.description: Corresponding network object in avi. It is a reference to an object of type network. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: opaque_network_id
options.description: Opaque network id. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: origin_id
options.description: Origin id applicable to security only cloud. Field introduced in 22.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: security_only_nsxt
options.description: Nsxt segment belongs to security only cloud. Field introduced in 22.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: segment_gw
options.description: Segment gateway. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: segment_gw6
options.description: V6 segment gateway. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: segment_id
options.description: Segment id. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: segname
options.description: Segment name. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: subnet
options.description: Segment cidr. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: subnet6
options.description: V6 segment cidr. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Nsxt segment belongs to tenant. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tier1_id
options.description: Tier1 router id. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vlan_ids
options.description: Segment vlan ids. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vrf_context_ref
options.description: Corresponding vrf context object in avi. It is a reference to an object of type vrfcontext. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
